item.title: Push-processed at the Barcelona Blues Festival
item.description:
On 13 July we took the lab out onto the street. Push processing workshop during the Barcelona Blues Festival.

Hector Oca, Álvaro Pascual Bascuñana and Jordi Beitia Gomá photographed the day on Kodak P3200 and developed it the same day. Here are some of the results.

item.title: Portrait workshop results — 15 June 2019
item.description: On Saturday 15 June we enjoyed having model Rima with us at the portrait workshop. Here are some of our students’ results.

item.title: Introduction to analogue photography workshop results
item.description:
Results from the latest introduction workshop. The students worked with a Rolleiflex f/3.5 and Fomapan 100 — and developed the roll during the same session.

There is something very concrete about seeing for the first time how an image appears on negatives you exposed yourself.

item.title: Portrait workshop results — 22 February 2019
item.description:
On 22 February we held a portrait workshop. Congratulations to everyone — it was a very productive and enjoyable session.

Click the image to see all the students’ photographs.

item.title: Portraits from 22 February
item.description:
Here are the portraits made by the students at the recent Portrait workshop at Llumàtics.

Well done, everyone.

item.title: Results from the Large Format workshop
item.description:
Results from the introductory Large Format workshop at Llumàtics.

4×5" black-and-white sheet film, developed in a tray. The image quality that large format delivers is hard to explain until you have it in your hands.
